body:
New features:
* Marks can now be removed by ctrl + left clicking a mark in the UI that is already assigned to your current target (as long as you are lead or assist) #11 
* Each raid mark icon in the UI now shows the number of group members currently targeting that raid mark #6
* the position of each raid icon in the UI can now be set via `/sraidmarks seticon {ICON_NAME} {X} {Y}` #10
